_comment: Neuron Flame remote model catalogue. Fetched by the app on launch + every 24h. Merged with the in-binary fallback list (TranscriptionModelRegistry.predefinedModels). Entries here ADD to or OVERRIDE the local list — they don't replace it. Schema versioned via `version` field; bump it when making breaking changes the client must understand.
_v2_notes: Schema v2 adds: origin (organization + country), trust_level (verified|community|custom), introduced (ISO date for recency tiebreaks), superseded_by (id of newer model that replaces this one — older versions get hidden from Local tab by default).

models.description: Higher-quality 8-bit quantized variant. Closer to full Large v3 Turbo accuracy at roughly half the size.
HuggingFace's distilled Whisper Large v3. ~6× faster than the original with 99% relative WER. English-focused.
Quantized tiny English-only model. Tiny enough to live entirely in cache — useful for short utterances on lower-spec Macs.
